title: ReactVLA: Fast and Lightweight Reactive Robot Manipulation via Improved Mean Flow Action Generation
summary: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong capability in modeling expressive and multimodal action distributions. However, their reliance on iterative sampling introduces substantial inference latency, which limits their applicability to reactive closed-loop robot manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose \texttt{ReactVLA}, a lightweight and low-latency VLA framework for real-time robotic manipulation. \texttt{ReactVLA} combines two complementary designs: (1) an improved Mean Flow (iMF) action generator that reduces expensive multi-step diffusion sampling to one-to-few-step action generation, and (2) Attention Residuals (AttnRes), a dynamic depth-wise feature routing mechanism that replaces uniform residual accumulation to better preserve task-relevant multimodal representations. We evaluate \texttt{ReactVLA} on large-scale simulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and RoboIMI, as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that \texttt{ReactVLA} consistently outperforms similarly sized VLA baselines, including SmolVLA and $π_0$. On challenging precision manipulation tasks, \texttt{ReactVLA} achieves up to a 1.65$\times$ improvement in task performance while providing more than a 4$\times$ increase in inference speed compared with leading VLA models. Finally, it reduces real-world policy latency to below 38.6 ms, enabling fast reactive control on physical robot platforms. Please check out our project website at: https://game-loader.github.io/ReactVLA/.
tldr: ReactVLA proposes a lightweight VLA framework for real-time robot manipulation, combining an improved Mean Flow action generator to reduce diffusion sampling steps and an Attention Residuals mechanism for better multimodal feature preservation, achieving up to 1.65x task performance and 4x speedup over baselines.
tldr_zh: ReactVLA 提出了一种轻量级 VLA 框架，用于实时机器人操作，通过改进平均流动作生成器减少扩散采样步骤，并利用注意力残差机制更好地保留多模态特征，相比基线模型实现了最高 1.65 倍的任务性能和 4 倍的推理速度提升。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在建模富有表现力的多模态动作分布方面展现出强大能力。然而，其对迭代采样的依赖会引入显著的推理延迟，从而限制了其在反应式闭环机器人操作场景中的应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出**ReactVLA**——一种用于实时机器人操作的轻量级低延迟VLA框架。**ReactVLA**融合了两种互补的设计：（1）改进平均流（iMF）动作生成器，将代价高昂的多步扩散采样缩减为一步到几步的动作生成；（2）注意力残差（AttnRes），一种动态的深度方向特征路由机制，取代了统一的残差累积，从而更好地保留与任务相关的多模态表征。我们在大规模仿真基准（包括LIBERO和RoboIMI）及真实机器人操作任务上评估了**ReactVLA**。实验结果表明，**ReactVLA**在性能上始终优于同等规模的VLA基线模型（包括SmolVLA和$π_0$）。在具有挑战性的精密操作任务中，与领先的VLA模型相比，**ReactVLA**的任务性能提升了高达1.65倍，同时推理速度提升了4倍以上。最终，它将真实场景中的策略延迟降低至38.6毫秒以下，从而在物理机器人平台上实现了快速反应式控制。欢迎访问我们的项目网站：https://game-loader.github.io/ReactVLA/。

title: From Attacks to Curricula: Learnability-Guided Adversarial Training for Safe Autonomous Driving
summary: Closed-loop adversarial training improves autonomous driving safety by exposing policies to rare safety-critical scenarios. Standard pipelines first generate adversarial scenarios and then sample them for policy optimization. However, most existing frameworks remain attack-oriented: collision-driven generators often synthesize unsolvable extreme situations, which can degrade learning, while heuristic samplers ignore the evolving capability of the driving policy, causing sample inefficiency and delayed convergence. We propose AlignADV, a learnability-guided closed-loop adversarial training framework that converts adversarial scenarios into resolvable and capability-aligned curricula. First, we reformulate adversarial scenario generation as a preference alignment problem and employ direct preference optimization to guide the generator toward critical yet resolvable scenarios. Second, we introduce behavioral fingerprints to capture the intrinsic characteristics of the evolving policy and construct a multi-modal capability prediction model that estimates policy performance without expensive closed-loop simulations. By combining resolvability-aligned scenarios with capability predictions, AlignADV develops a dynamic curriculum sampling mechanism that prioritizes scenarios targeting the current policy's vulnerabilities. Experiments on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset demonstrate that AlignADV improves convergence efficiency and final performance, reducing training steps by up to 40.6 percent compared with baseline methods while lowering collision rate and improving route completion under both normal and adversarial traffic conditions. These results highlight a shift from attack-oriented scenario generation to learnability-guided policy improvement, offering a principled direction for safer and more efficient autonomous driving training. Project page: https://meiyuewen.github.io/AlignADV/.
tldr: AlignADV proposes a learnability-guided adversarial training framework for autonomous driving that uses direct preference optimization to generate resolvable scenarios and a multi-modal capability prediction model for dynamic curriculum sampling, improving convergence efficiency and safety.
tldr_zh: AlignADV提出了一种可学习性指导的自动驾驶对抗训练框架，通过直接偏好优化生成可解场景，并利用多模态能力预测模型进行动态课程采样，提升收敛效率和安全性。
summary_zh: 闭环对抗训练通过将驾驶策略暴露于罕见的安全关键场景中，从而提升自动驾驶安全性。标准流程首先生成对抗场景，然后对其进行采样以供策略优化。然而，现有框架大多仍以攻击为导向：碰撞驱动的生成器往往合成无法解决的极端情况，这可能导致学习效果下降；而启发式采样器忽视了驾驶策略的演进能力，造成采样效率低下及收敛延迟。我们提出AlignADV——一种基于可学习性的闭环对抗训练框架，该框架将对抗场景转化为可解决且与能力对齐的课程。首先，我们将对抗场景生成重新表述为偏好对齐问题，并采用直接偏好优化来引导生成器朝向关键但可解决的场景。其次，我们引入行为指纹来捕捉演进策略的内在特性，并构建一个多模态能力预测模型，无需昂贵的闭环仿真即可估计策略性能。通过将可解决性对齐场景与能力预测相结合，AlignADV开发了一种动态课程采样机制，该机制优先选择针对当前策略弱点的场景。在Waymo开放运动数据集上的实验表明，AlignADV提高了收敛效率和最终性能，相比基线方法最多可减少40.6%的训练步数，同时在正常与对抗交通条件下均能降低碰撞率并提升路线完成度。这些结果突显了从攻击导向的场景生成向可学习性引导的策略改进的转变，为更安全、更高效的自动驾驶训练提供了原则性方向。项目页面：https://meiyuewen.github.io/AlignADV/。

title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at mapping visual inputs and natural language instructions directly to robotic control policies. However, because they are trained primarily to fit behavioural demonstration data, they do not explicitly enforce fundamental physical principles such as rigid-body dynamics or contact constraints. This exposes a critical physics gap: standard temporal smoothing applied on top of single-step or chunked VLAs trades trajectory quality for added failures that short-term memory cannot resolve. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysVLA (Physics-VLA), a plug-and-play, inference-time framework designed to wrap any frozen VLA backbone without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, with less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. PhysVLA intercepts the predicted control action, captures only the simulator or system state, and applies a dual-layered correction: (i) a phase-aware finite-state machine that structures discrete task segments (approach, grasp, transport, and place), and (ii) a selective Euler-Lagrange gate that activates only when a dynamics oracle detects kinodynamic inconsistency. Evaluated across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on LIBERO-Spatial with a 7-DoF Franka Panda, the framework delivers absolute success rate increases of up to 17% and stability increases of up to 19% with no per-task regressions, improves trajectory efficiency by up to 15% across all four backbones, and shows up to a 10x improvement in trajectory jerk robustness on a Robosuite Lift cross-simulator sweep. We further validate the framework on a real Agilex Piper arm with a pick-and-place task, confirming that PhysVLA transfers to physical hardware without retraining, with success-rate improvements of up to 50%, establishing physical awareness as a composable, backbone-agnostic runtime module.
tldr: PhysVLA is a plug-and-play inference-time framework that wraps frozen VLA backbones with a phase-aware finite-state machine and selective Euler-Lagrange gate to enforce physical consistency, achieving significant success-rate and stability improvements on simulated and real robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: PhysVLA 是一种即插即用的推理时框架，通过相位感知有限状态机和选择性欧拉-拉格朗日门来包裹冻结的VLA骨干网络，强制执行物理一致性，在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中显著提升了成功率和稳定性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型擅长将视觉输入和自然语言指令直接映射为机器人控制策略。然而，由于这些模型主要基于行为演示数据进行训练，它们并未显式地强制执行刚体动力学或接触约束等基本物理原理。这揭示了关键的物理缺失：在单步或分块VLA基础上施加的标准时间平滑处理，以轨迹质量为代价换取了短期记忆无法解决的额外故障。为弥补这一缺陷，我们提出PhysVLA（Physics-VLA），一种即插即用的推理时框架，旨在无需重新训练、微调或权重访问的前提下封装任意冻结的VLA主干，每个控制步骤的额外开销不到1毫秒。PhysVLA拦截预测的控制动作，仅捕获模拟器或系统状态，并施加双层修正：(i) 基于相位感知的有限状态机，用于结构化离散任务阶段（接近、抓取、搬运和放置）；(ii) 选择性欧拉-拉格朗日门控机制，仅在动力学预检测器发现运动学-动力学不一致时激活。在LIBERO-Spatial环境中使用7自由度Franka Panda机器人对OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA和Generalist-VLA进行的评估表明，该框架在无任务退化的情况下，绝对成功率提升最高达17%，稳定性提升最高达19%，所有四种主干网络的轨迹效率提升最高达15%，且在Robosuite Lift跨模拟器扫描中轨迹急动度鲁棒性提升最高达10倍。我们进一步在真实的Agilex Piper机械臂上通过拾放任务验证了该框架，证实PhysVLA可在无需重新训练的情况下迁移至物理硬件，成功率提升最高达50%，从而将物理感知确立为一种可组合、主干无关的运行时模块。

title: Output-Level Regularization Eliminates the Seed Lottery in Single-GPU VLA Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action model (VLA-JEPA) on a single GPU should be simple: load a pretrained checkpoint, run training, deploy. There is a hidden danger. Run the same fine-tuning code thirteen times -- same data, same architecture, different random seed -- and twelve runs produce a robot succeeding 91--94% of the time, while one run silently degrades to 65.2%: a 29 pp gap with no error message, no warning, and no way to predict which seed will fail. We call this the seed lottery. We trace the cause to output collapse: the action predictor quietly learns to produce nearly identical outputs regardless of what the robot sees. Existing weight-level methods (L2, EWC) are structurally blind to this collapse -- they penalize weight changes, but collapse occurs in directions weights can move freely without affecting outputs, a gap we formalize via the Jacobian null-space. Across 7 methods x up to 13 seeds x 3 LIBERO benchmarks, three output-level regularizers -- VICReg (n=12 seeds), Dropout (n=4), and a halved learning rate (n=5) -- each eliminate every catastrophic seed (0/21 combined collapses vs. 1/13 Baseline; F(12,11)=28.7, p<0.001), while weight-level methods (L2, EWC) preserve the lottery. The simplest fix is changing one number in your optimizer config.
tldr: This paper identifies and solves the 'seed lottery' problem in single-GPU VLA fine-tuning, where random seeds can cause catastrophic performance drops due to output collapse; output-level regularization methods like VICReg, Dropout, and halved learning rate eliminate this failure mode, while weight-level methods do not.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并解决了单GPU VLA微调中的“种子彩票”问题，即随机种子可能导致输出坍缩进而引发性能暴跌；输出级正则化方法（如VICReg、Dropout和减半学习率）能消除这一故障模式，而权重级方法则无效。
summary_zh: 在单GPU上微调视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA-JEPA）本应简单：加载预训练检查点、运行训练、部署。但其中暗藏隐患。将同一微调代码重复运行十三次——相同数据、相同架构、不同随机种子——其中十二次运行的机器人成功率达91-94%，而一次运行则悄无声息地降至65.2%：性能差距达29个百分点，且无错误信息、无警告，更无法预测哪个种子会失败。我们将此称为种子彩票。追踪其根源，发现是输出坍缩所致：无论机器人看到什么，动作预测器都会悄然学会产生近乎相同的输出。现有的权重级方法（L2、EWC）在结构上对此坍缩视而不见——它们惩罚权重变化，但坍缩发生在权重可自由移动而不影响输出的方向上，这一差异我们通过雅可比零空间进行了形式化描述。在7种方法×最多13个种子×3个LIBERO基准测试中，三种输出级正则化器——VICReg（n=12种子）、Dropout（n=4）和减半学习率（n=5）——各自消除了所有灾难性种子（合计0/21坍缩，对比基线1/13；F(12,11)=28.7，p<0.001），而权重级方法（L2、EWC）则保留了彩票效应。最简单的修复方法是更改优化器配置中的一个数字。

title: EgoGuide: Egocentric Guidance for Efficient Robot-Free Demonstration Collection and Learning
summary: Robot learning from real-world demonstrations is currently constrained by data scaling. Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) provides an efficient robot-free data collection interface, yet current UMI-style pipelines often collect redundant demonstrations and lack global scene context. To improve data efficiency, we present EgoGuide, a collection interface that records synchronized wrist and head/egocentric observations and couples them with online visual-geometric data quality guidance. We also introduce a Gated Egocentric Residual Policy for robust learning from a viewpoint-varying egocentric camera, allowing head/egocentric context to correct ambiguous local observations while preserving stable wrist-view control. Real-world experiments show that EgoGuide reduces the required number of data episodes and improves data efficiency. The residual policy further improves robustness under visual occlusion. Project Page: https://silicx.github.io/EgoGuide
tldr: EgoGuide proposes a robot-free data collection interface with egocentric guidance and a Gated Egocentric Residual Policy to improve data efficiency and robustness in robotic manipulation learning from demonstrations.
tldr_zh: EgoGuide提出了一种无机器人数据收集接口，结合自我中心引导和门控自我中心残差策略，提高了机器人操作学习中的数据效率和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 从真实世界演示中学习机器人技术目前受到数据规模的限制。通用操作接口（UMI）提供了一种高效的无需机器人的数据收集接口，但当前UMI风格的数据流水线通常会收集冗余的演示数据，并且缺乏全局场景上下文。为了提高数据效率，我们提出了EgoGuide，一种同步记录腕部与头部/自我中心观测数据，并将其与在线视觉-几何数据质量指导相结合的收集接口。我们还引入了一种门控自我中心残差策略，用于从视角变化的自我中心相机中进行鲁棒学习，该策略允许头部/自我中心上下文纠正模糊的局部观测，同时保持稳定的腕部视角控制。真实世界实验表明，EgoGuide减少了所需的数据集数，并提高了数据效率。该残差策略进一步提升了视觉遮挡下的鲁棒性。项目页面：https://silicx.github.io/EgoGuide

title: Whole-Body Impedance Model Predictive Control for Safe Physical Human--Robot Interaction on Floating-Base Platforms
summary: Floating-base robots must balance under rigid contact constraints while interacting safely with humans. Existing whole-body control~(WBC) frameworks allocate the full joint space to locomotion or rely on fixed-gain impedance feedback that accumulates steady-state error under sustained physical human--robot interaction~(pHRI) forces. This paper extends the authors' fixed-base two-layer Impedance MPC to floating-base platforms through a three-level architecture: a centroidal MPC plans contact forces over a 500\,ms horizon; a priority-driven WBC layer resolves balance into joint torques through contact-consistent null-space projection; and the residual null space is governed by a receding-horizon quadratic program~(QP) that predicts and rejects pHRI disturbances using a Kalman-augmented state. A contact-consistent feedback linearization reduces the arm end-effector plant to a double integrator with a \emph{constant} state matrix within each contact mode, enabling offline precomputation of the QP cost and ${\geq}1$\,kHz operation. A covariance-inflation protocol preserves the disturbance estimate across contact-mode switches, guaranteeing zero steady-state error under bounded constant pHRI loads, and an Impedance Equivalence Theorem shows the infinite-horizon limit recovers a classical task-space impedance law whose effective mass, damping, and stiffness adapt to posture and contact configuration. Simulations on a 17-DOF biped and the Unitree G1 humanoid validate the design.
tldr: This paper proposes a three-level whole-body impedance model predictive control framework for floating-base robots that achieves safe physical human-robot interaction with zero steady-state error under sustained disturbances.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对浮动基座机器人的三级全身阻抗模型预测控制框架，能在持续物理人机交互干扰下实现零稳态误差的安全操作。
summary_zh: 浮动基座机器人必须在刚性接触约束下保持平衡，同时与人类进行安全交互。现有的全身控制框架将整个关节空间分配给 locomotion，或依赖固定增益阻抗反馈，该反馈在持续的人机物理交互力作用下会产生稳态误差。本文将作者此前提出的固定基座双层阻抗MPC扩展至浮动基座平台，采用三层架构：质心MPC在500毫秒时域内规划接触力；优先级驱动的WBC层通过接触一致零空间投影将平衡任务分解为关节力矩；剩余零空间由一个滚动时域二次规划控制器支配，该控制器利用卡尔曼增强状态估计并抑制pHRI扰动。通过接触一致反馈线性化，可将机械臂末端执行器模型简化为在每个接触模式下具有恒定状态矩阵的双积分器，从而实现QP成本的离线预计算和1 kHz以上的运行频率。协方差膨胀协议可在接触模式切换时保持扰动估计，确保在有界恒定pHRI负载下实现零稳态误差；阻抗等价定理表明，无限时域极限可恢复经典任务空间阻抗定律，其有效质量、阻尼和刚度能够自适应姿态与接触构型。通过在17自由度双足机器人和宇树G1人形机器人上的仿真验证了该设计的有效性。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Highway Driving: A Unified Framework for Safety and Efficiency
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) offers a compelling route to decision-making for advanced autonomous vehicles (AVs), yet its trial-and-error nature makes it difficult to guarantee safety during training and to achieve both safety and efficiency at deployment. We propose a unified safe reinforcement learning (SRL) framework that integrates safe distance (SD), reward machines (RM), and mixture-of-experts (MoE), termed MoE-RM-SRL. For deployment, SD and RM jointly shape a rule-aware reward that encodes highway traffic regulations and stage-wise objectives, enabling safe and reliable behavior without sacrificing efficiency. For training, we introduce a sparsely gated MoE layer comprising up to 11 deep Q-networks (DQNs); an SD-based gating rule activates a minimal set of experts for lane-keeping and lane-changing, mitigating the instability, discontinuities, and impulsive transients commonly induced by switching between heterogeneous controllers (e.g., MPC/rule-based modules and learned policies). We implement the proposed architecture in CARLA and integrate it with a 6-DoF driver-in-the-loop virtual-reality (DiL-VR) platform. Experiments in stochastic two-lane traffic show that MoE-RM-SRL substantially improves safety and efficiency over state-of-the-art baselines, and the framework naturally extends to multi-lane driving as well as on-ramp merging and exiting scenarios.
tldr: A unified safe reinforcement learning framework (MoE-RM-SRL) that integrates safe distance, reward machines, and mixture-of-experts to improve both safety and efficiency in autonomous highway driving, validated in CARLA and a driver-in-the-loop VR platform.
tldr_zh: 提出一个统一的安全强化学习框架 (MoE-RM-SRL)，融合安全距离、奖励机器和专家混合机制，在保证安全的同时提升自动驾驶高速公路行驶的效率，并在CARLA和驾驶员在环VR平台上验证。
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（DRL）为高级自动驾驶车辆（AVs）的决策制定提供了极具吸引力的路径，但其试错特性导致在训练过程中难以保障安全性，也难以在部署时同时实现安全与效率。我们提出了一种统一的安全强化学习（SRL）框架，该框架集成了安全距离（SD）、奖励机（RM）与混合专家模型（MoE），命名为MoE-RM-SRL。在部署阶段，SD与RM联合构建了符合规则的奖励函数，该函数编码了高速公路交通规则与分阶段目标，在不牺牲效率的前提下实现安全可靠的行为。在训练阶段，我们引入了一个由最多11个深度Q网络（DQNs）组成的稀疏门控MoE层；基于SD的门控规则激活最小数量的专家用于车道保持与车道变换，从而缓解了异构控制器（如MPC/基于规则的模块与学习策略）切换时常见的失稳、不连续性及脉冲瞬变。我们在CARLA中实现了所提出的架构，并将其集成至一个六自由度驾驶员在环虚拟现实（DiL-VR）平台。在随机双车道交通流中的实验表明，MoE-RM-SRL在安全性与效率方面显著优于当前最先进的基线方法，且该框架可自然扩展至多车道驾驶以及匝道合流与驶离场景。

title: Impedance MPC with Disturbance Estimation for Dexterous Hand Control
summary: Dexterous hands must simultaneously track precise finger trajectories and maintain safe, compliant contact -- objectives in tension for any fixed-gain controller. We present an actuator-agnostic Impedance Model Predictive Control (Impedance MPC) framework for dexterous fingers, instantiating the constant-$A_d$ offset-free architecture established for physical human-robot interaction (pHRI); its stability, recursive-feasibility, and input-to-state-stability guarantees are inherited by preserving the architectural assumptions. An algebraic feedforward reduces the tendon transmission -- hydraulic, cable, pneumatic, twisted-string, or series-elastic -- to a constant-coefficient double integrator, so the QP cost inverse is precomputed offline and a 10-step receding-horizon quadratic program runs at 500\,Hz while enforcing hard constraints on contact force (ISO/TS 15066), actuation limits, and jerk. An encoder-only augmented-Kalman disturbance state drives steady-state error to zero under any constant contact load. On a hydraulically actuated finger -- the worked example platform, adding pressure and cavitation constraints -- the 500\,Hz Kalman MPC attains 0.5\,mrad RMS, 0.1\,mrad steady-state, and 6.6\,mrad peak deflection under 1.5\,Nm contact: 183$\times$, 1500$\times$, and 23$\times$ better than classical impedance. The realized first-move stiffness (18$\to$323\,Nm/rad with update rate) is independently verified. The architecture scales to a 16-DOF LEAP Hand MuJoCo simulation, recovering from 2.5\,N grasp-load disturbances within 0.7\,s.
tldr: This paper presents an Impedance MPC framework for dexterous hand control that combines disturbance estimation and offline QP computation to achieve precise, safe, high-frequency control on real hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于灵巧手的阻抗模型预测控制框架，结合扰动估计与离线QP计算，在真实硬件上实现了精确、安全、高频的控制。
summary_zh: 灵巧手必须同时跟踪精确的手指轨迹并维持安全、柔顺的接触——这对于任何固定增益控制器而言都是相互冲突的目标。我们提出了一种与执行机构无关的灵巧手指阻抗模型预测控制（Impedance MPC）框架，实例化了为物理人机交互（pHRI）建立的恒定$A_d$无偏移架构；通过保留架构假设，其稳定性、递归可行性及输入-状态稳定性保证得以继承。一种代数前馈将肌腱传动（液压、缆绳、气动、绞线或串联弹性）简化为常系数双积分器，因此二次规划（QP）代价矩阵的逆可离线预计算，且一个10步滚动时域二次规划以500\,Hz频率运行，同时强制执行接触力（ISO/TS 15066）、驱动限制及加加速度的硬约束。仅采用编码器的增广卡尔曼扰动状态在任意恒定接触负载下将稳态误差归零。在液压驱动手指（作为实例验证平台，额外施加压力和空化约束）上，该500\,Hz卡尔曼MPC在1.5\,Nm接触负载下实现了0.5\,mrad均方根误差、0.1\,mrad稳态误差及6.6\,mrad峰值偏转：比经典阻抗控制分别提升183倍、1500倍和23倍。其实现的首动刚度（随更新率从18变化至323\,Nm/rad）经独立验证。该架构可扩展至16自由度LEAP Hand MuJoCo仿真，在0.7\,秒内从2.5\,N抓取负载扰动中恢复。

title: ORCA: A Platform for Open-Source Dexterity Research
summary: Robotics manipulation research increasingly focuses on two-finger parallel grippers for their effectiveness, affordability, and ease of teleoperation. Grippers are nonetheless limited by their form factor, often requiring bimanual setups even for simple reorientation tasks. Anthropomorphic hands are a more natural platform for dexterous robot learning -- closer to the human hand, and capable of learning from human video -- yet they remain hard to use in learning research: even where open and accessible hand hardware exists, the software for control, simulation, teleoperation, and retargeting is scattered in one-off code bases, and largely disconnected from the robot-learning ecosystem. In this work, we introduce the \orca~learning stack, an open-source research stack for dexterity as a first-class robot learning domain. Our \orca~stack unifies low-level control, simulation, teleoperation from a range of consumer platforms, and hand retargeting, behind a single interface, and integrates natively with popular robot-learning frameworks such as \lerobot, so dexterous hand researchers can leverage the same data, training, and evaluation pipelines used for non-dexterous robot learning. We demonstrate a complete end-to-end workflow, collecting expert demonstrations of an in-hand reorientation task by teleoperation with a consumer-grade VR headset, training an autonomous policy with \lerobot, and evaluating the learned policy in a fully reproducible and observable setup. We open-source the entire stack as a shared, reproducible foundation for dexterous-manipulation research.
tldr: Introduces ORCA, an open-source software stack unifying low-level control, simulation, teleoperation, and retargeting for dexterous robotic hand research, integrating with robot-learning frameworks and demonstrating an end-to-end manipulation workflow.
tldr_zh: 提出ORCA，一个开源软件栈，统一了灵巧手研究的底层控制、仿真、遥操作和重定向，集成到机器人学习框架中，并展示了端到端的操作工作流程。
summary_zh: 机器人操作研究日益关注双指平行夹爪，因其高效、低成本且易于远程操控。但夹爪受自身构型限制，即便执行简单的物体重定向任务，也常需双臂操作。拟人化手部是灵巧机器人学习的更自然平台——更接近人手结构，且能通过人类视频进行学习——然而这类手部在机器人学习研究中仍难以应用：即便存在开源且易用的手部硬件，其控制、仿真、遥操作及重定向软件仍分散于临时性代码库中，与机器人学习生态系统严重脱节。本研究提出\orca~学习栈——将灵巧操作作为机器人学习首要领域的开源研究平台。我们的\orca~栈通过统一接口整合底层控制、仿真、多消费级平台遥操作及手部重定向功能，并原生集成\lerobot等主流机器人学习框架，使灵巧手研究者能复用与非灵巧机器人学习相同的数据采集、训练及评估流程。我们展示了完整的端到端工作流：通过消费级VR头显遥操作采集手内重定向任务的专家演示，利用\lerobot训练自主策略，并在完全可复现、可观测的配置中评估学习策略。我们将整个技术栈开源，作为灵巧操作研究的共享可复现基础。

title: Spatially Conditioned Diffusion Policy: Learning Precise and Robust Manipulation with a Single RGB Camera
summary: Recent visual imitation learning systems have widely adopted multi-camera setups with wrist-mounted cameras as the de facto standard. However, manipulation from a single global view remains challenging, as the policy should capture fine-grained interaction details and identify task-relevant regions without local wrist views. To address this challenge, we present Spatially Conditioned Diffusion Policy (SCDP), a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that achieves precise and robust manipulation in a single-camera setting. Our key idea is that end-effector trajectories can serve as visual attention anchors that reflect task-relevant regions. Building on this idea, SCDP consists of two key components: (i) a visual encoder that produces multi-scale feature maps to capture both broader context and fine-grained visual features, and (ii) a spatial conditioning module that samples point-wise features along intermediate end-effector trajectories in the diffusion loop. Extensive simulation experiments show that SCDP consistently outperforms strong single-view baselines and achieves performance comparable to multi-camera baselines. Real-world experiments further demonstrate precise manipulation and robustness to visual distractors, highlighting the potential of single-camera imitation learning.
tldr: SCDP is a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that achieves precise single-camera manipulation by using end-effector trajectories as visual attention anchors, eliminating the need for multi-camera setups.
tldr_zh: SCDP 是一种基于扩散的视觉运动策略，通过将末端执行器轨迹作为视觉注意力锚点，实现了仅用单摄像头进行精确操作，无需多摄像头配置。
summary_zh: 近期，视觉模仿学习系统已广泛采用多摄像头设置，并将腕部摄像头作为事实标准。然而，在单一全局视角下完成操作任务仍具挑战性，因为策略需在缺少局部腕部视角的情况下捕捉精细交互细节并识别任务相关区域。为解决这一问题，我们提出空间条件扩散策略（SCDP），这是一种基于扩散的视觉运动策略，可在单摄像头设置中实现精确且鲁棒的操作。其核心思路在于：末端执行器轨迹可充当反映任务相关区域的视觉注意力锚点。基于此，SCDP包含两个关键组件：（i）生成多尺度特征图的视觉编码器，以同时捕捉全局上下文与精细视觉特征；（ii）在扩散循环中沿中间末端执行器轨迹采样点式特征的空间条件模块。大量仿真实验表明，SCDP持续优于强单视角基线方法，性能可媲美多摄像头基线方法。真实世界实验进一步验证了其精确操作能力与对视觉干扰物的鲁棒性，展现了单摄像头模仿学习的潜力。

title: AERMANI-PLACE: Language Guided Object Placement with Aerial Manipulators
summary:
Object placement is a fundamental component of aerial manipulation tasks, yet existing systems typically require the desired placement position to be specified explicitly in metric coordinates. Such interfaces are not intuitive and require users to reason about coordinate frames and scene geometry, making them difficult to use in practical deployments. In contrast, humans often communicate spatial goals through a combination of language and pointing gestures. Inspired by this observation, we present AERMANI-PLACE, a framework for language-guided object placement with aerial manipulators. Given a scene image and a natural language instruction, an image editing model generates a modified version of the scene containing a visual marker that indicates where the object should be placed. This marker is then grounded into the physical environment using depth observations to recover a metric place point, after which a placement trajectory is generated and executed by the aerial manipulator. We evaluate the proposed approach on a test set of 100 language-guided placement tasks and demonstrate successful execution on a real aerial manipulation platform. Experimental results show that the proposed method reliably infers placement locations from language instructions with an average success rate of 87\% on the test-set and transfers effectively to real-world aerial manipulation with an average success rate of 72\%.
  Video: https://youtu.be/SgwwgLBsv0g
tldr: AERMANI-PLACE uses an image editing model and depth grounding to infer placement locations from natural language instructions for aerial manipulators, achieving 87% success in simulation and 72% on a real platform.
tldr_zh: AERMANI-PLACE 利用图像编辑模型和深度信息，从自然语言指令中推断放置位置，并在空中机械臂上实现模拟87%和实际72%的成功率。
summary_zh:
物体放置是空中操控任务的基本组成部分，然而现有系统通常要求以公制坐标明确指定期望的放置位置。这类交互界面不够直观，需要用户理解坐标系与场景几何，导致其在实际部署中难以使用。相比之下，人类通常通过语言与指向手势相结合的方式传达空间目标。受此启发，我们提出了AERMANI-PLACE——一种面向空中操控器的语言引导物体放置框架。给定场景图像与自然语言指令，图像编辑模型生成场景的修改版本，其中包含指示物体应放置位置的视觉标记。随后利用深度观测将该标记映射到物理环境中以恢复公制放置点，进而由空中操控器生成并执行放置轨迹。我们在包含100项语言引导放置任务的测试集上评估了所提方法，并在真实空中操控平台上验证了其成功执行能力。实验结果表明，所提方法能可靠地从语言指令中推断放置位置，测试集平均成功率达87%，并能有效迁移至真实空中操控场景，平均成功率达72%。  
视频链接：https://youtu.be/SgwwgLBsv0g

title: CADET: Physics-Grounded Causal Auditing and Training-Free Deconfounding of End-to-End Driving Planners
summary: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous-driving planners trained by imitation are prone to statistical shortcuts: they associate scene elements that merely co-occur with expert actions (a roadside object, a building facade) with driving decisions, rather than the variables that causally determine them. Such causal confusion silently compromises reliability in long-tail scenarios, and it is difficult to detect, because prevailing open-loop metrics (L2 displacement and collision rate) are dominated by ego status and do not indicate whether a planner depends on spurious cues. Existing remedies based on causal-intervention training require retraining large models and cannot audit a planner that is already deployed. We present CADET, a training-free framework that audits, benchmarks, and repairs spurious reliance in pretrained E2E planners without any parameter update.
tldr: CADET introduces a training-free framework to audit and repair spurious correlations in pretrained end-to-end driving planners without parameter updates.
tldr_zh: CADET 提出一个无需训练的框架，用于审计和修复预训练端到端驾驶规划器中的虚假相关性，而无需更新参数。
summary_zh: 端到端（E2E）自动驾驶规划器通过模仿学习易陷入统计捷径：它们将仅与专家动作共现的场景元素（如路边物体、建筑立面）与驾驶决策相关联，而非因果决定决策的变量。这种因果混淆会悄无声息地损害长尾场景下的可靠性，且难以检测——因为主流的开环指标（L2位移与碰撞率）主要由自车状态决定，无法反映规划器是否依赖虚假线索。现有基于因果干预训练的修复方法需要重新训练大型模型，且无法审计已部署的规划器。我们提出CADET——一种无需训练即可审计、基准测试并修复预训练端到端规划器中虚假依赖的框架，无需任何参数更新。

title: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack
summary: In this report, we present Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA, abbreviated as HyVLA-0.5, an end-to-end system that spans the full robot learning stack: data collection, model design, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. Each component serves a distinct role in this stack.
tldr: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA presents a complete robot learning stack from data collection to deployment, integrating VLA models with RL post-training.
tldr_zh: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA 提出了一个完整的机器人学习堆栈，涵盖数据收集、模型设计、预训练、微调、RL后训练和实际部署。
summary_zh: 在本报告中，我们提出了Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA（简称HyVLA-0.5），这是一个覆盖完整机器人学习技术栈的端到端系统，包括数据采集、模型设计、持续预训练与有监督微调、强化学习后训练以及真实环境部署。该技术栈中的每个组件均发挥着独特作用。

title: Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning: Self-Aware Policy Execution for VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are powerful action generators for robot manipulation, but they are typically executed with fixed inference and replanning schedules. This rigidity ignores the uneven difficulty of robot control: contact-rich or uncertain states may need more computation and fresher feedback, while easier states can often be handled with fewer inference steps and longer open-loop execution. We propose Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning (EQRL), a framework that makes each VLA policy query elastic. A lightweight latent-schedule adaptor jointly selects the latent input, denoising budget, and action chunk length, without fine-tuning the underlying VLA model. To make scheduling difficulty-aware, EQRL trains a critic over the joint latent-schedule action and derives a state difficulty signal from critic ensemble disagreement. This signal guides compute toward difficult states, while a learned residual allows task-driven correction. We formulate variable chunk execution as query-level macro-action RL with chunk-dependent discounting and an amortized number-of-function-evaluations (NFE) budget. Across simulation and real-robot manipulation, EQRL reduces amortized inference cost while preserving or improving task success.
tldr: EQRL introduces a reinforcement learning framework that makes VLA model queries elastic by dynamically selecting latent input, denoising budget, and action chunk length based on state difficulty, reducing inference cost while maintaining or improving task success in robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: EQRL提出了一种强化学习框架，通过根据状态难度动态选择潜在输入、去噪预算和动作块长度，使VLA模型的查询具有弹性，从而在保持或提升任务成功率的同时降低推理成本。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是机器人操作中强大的动作生成器，但通常以固定推理和重规划周期执行。这种刚性忽视了机器人控制的不均匀难度：接触密集或不确定状态可能需要更多计算和更及时的反馈，而简单状态通常可通过更少的推理步骤和更长的开环执行来处理。我们提出弹性查询强化学习（EQRL）框架，使每个VLA策略查询具备弹性。一个轻量级潜在调度适配器协同选择潜在输入、去噪预算和动作块长度，无需微调底层VLA模型。为实现调度难度感知，EQRL在联合潜在调度动作上训练评判器，并从评判器集成分歧中推导状态难度信号。该信号引导计算资源投向困难状态，而学习到的残差则允许任务驱动校正。我们将可变块执行形式化为查询级宏动作强化学习，采用依赖块的折扣和分摊的函数评估次数（NFE）预算。在仿真和真实机器人操作实验中，EQRL在保持或提升任务成功率的同时，降低了分摊推理成本。

title: FloVerse: Floor Plan-Guided Multi-Modal Navigation
summary: Floor plans encapsulate compact spatial priors, enabling agents to navigate unseen scenes more efficiently. While prior work has explored floor plan-guided navigation, it has focused mainly on PointNav and a limited set of environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce FloVerse, a new task for floor plan-guided embodied navigation that unifies PointNav, ObjectNav, and ImageNav. To support FloVerse, we assemble FloVerse-1.6K, a large-scale dataset of 1.6K scenes from HM3D and Gibson 4+, paired with corresponding floor plans, comprising 240K expert trajectories and 12M RGBD frames. We further propose ThreeDiff, a two-stage imitation learning policy comprising a planner, a diffusion-based multimodal goal-reasoning module trained via masked-modality modeling, and a refiner, a depth-based trajectory-refinement module for safe execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that (1) floor-plan priors improve navigation performance across all goal modalities, and (2) ThreeDiff implicitly captures spatial information from floor plans. These results underscore the effectiveness of spatial priors and validate our proposed unified approach for floor plan-guided embodied navigation.
tldr: FloVerse introduces a unified floor plan-guided navigation task covering PointNav, ObjectNav, and ImageNav, with a large-scale dataset and a two-stage imitation learning policy that leverages spatial priors from floor plans to improve embodied navigation.
tldr_zh: FloVerse提出了一个统一的楼层平面引导导航任务，涵盖PointNav、ObjectNav和ImageNav，附带大规模数据集和两阶段模仿学习策略，利用楼层平面中的空间先验提升具身导航能力。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
平面图包含了紧凑的空间先验信息，使智能体能够更高效地在未见场景中导航。尽管已有研究探索了平面图引导的导航，但主要集中于PointNav及有限的环境集合。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了FloVerse——一个面向平面图引导具身导航的新任务，统一了PointNav、ObjectNav和ImageNav三种导航模式。为支持FloVerse，我们构建了FloVerse-1.6K数据集，该大规模数据集包含来自HM3D和Gibson 4+的1600个场景及其对应的平面图，涵盖24万条专家轨迹和1200万帧RGBD图像。我们进一步提出ThreeDiff，一种两阶段模仿学习策略，包含规划器（基于扩散的多模态目标推理模块，通过掩码模态建模训练）和精调器（基于深度的轨迹精调模块，用于安全执行）。大量实验表明：(1) 平面图先验信息能提升所有目标模态下的导航性能；(2) ThreeDiff可隐式地从平面图中捕获空间信息。这些结果凸显了空间先验的有效性，并验证了我们提出的统一方法在平面图引导具身导航中的可行性。

title: When and How Severely: Scenario-Specific Safety Envelopes for Driving VLAs
summary: Safety certification of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving planners under ISO 21448 (SOTIF) rests on an Operational Design Domain (ODD) specification that answers two complementary questions: when does the planner start to fail, and how severely does it fail once it does? We evaluate Alpamayo R1, a 10B-parameter open-weight driving VLA, on 15,968 (clip, attack) pairs. We find a conservative-aggregate gap: an aggregate safe threshold of $σ\leq 50$ under a 15% average displacement error (ADE) budget masks well-sampled scenarios that tolerate the top of the tested grid ($σ= 70$). A Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) on the changed-explanation subset identifies six discrete severity bands (BIC-optimal $k{=}6$), so two perturbation conditions with the same mean error can differ materially in their share of high-severity (C4/C5) failures. Joining the two analyses on the same corpus surfaces a finding neither yields in isolation: the scenarios with the loosest noise thresholds are not those with the lowest high-severity rate: STOP_SIGNAL concentrates roughly $4\times$ the C4/C5 share of LANE_KEEPING despite tolerating a larger $σ$. A deployable SOTIF ODD specification for driving VLAs therefore requires a two-dimensional safety envelope, not a single aggregate value per hazard.
tldr: This paper evaluates a driving VLA model's safety under ISO 21448, revealing that a single aggregate safety threshold is insufficient; a two-dimensional safety envelope per hazard is needed for ODD specification.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了驾驶VLA模型在ISO 21448下的安全性，发现单一的聚合安全阈值不足，需要为每个危险指定二维安全包络。
summary_zh: 根据ISO 21448（SOTIF）标准，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶规划器的安全认证依赖于运行设计域（ODD）规范，该规范需回答两个互补问题：规划器何时开始失效，以及一旦失效其严重程度如何？我们基于15968个（片段，攻击）配对样本评估了拥有100亿参数的开放权重驾驶VLA模型Alpamayo R1。研究发现一个保守聚合缺口：在15%平均位移误差（ADE）预算下，聚合安全阈值σ≤50掩盖了能承受测试网格上限（σ=70）的充分采样场景。针对解释变化子集的高斯混合模型（GMM）识别出六个离散严重度区间（BIC最优k=6），表明均值误差相同的两种扰动条件在高严重度（C4/C5）故障占比上可能存在显著差异。将两种分析应用于同一语料库时，发现单一分析无法揭示的现象：噪声阈值最宽松的场景并非高严重度率最低的场景——STOP_SIGNAL虽然能容忍更大的σ值，但其C4/C5占比约为LANE_KEEPING的4倍。因此，面向驾驶VLA的可部署SOTIF ODD规范需要构建二维安全包络，而非针对每类危险仅设置单一聚合值。

title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback
summary: For robots to work safely in household environments, they need to be compliant and react to torque and force feedback during contact. However, the majority of existing data collection pipelines still lack the ability to capture force and torque data for learning active compliant policies. In this paper, we present Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton (UME), an upper-limb exoskeleton that provides real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torque signals for teleoperation. With transparent torque feedback, human operators can even unsheathe kinematically constrained objects while blindfolded. UME is low-cost, lightweight, and portable. Equipped with an embedded IMU, it enables teleoperation for mobile manipulation. With our proposed universal retargeting algorithm, UME can teleoperate a range of robots, including the 7DoF OpenArm, 7DoF Franka, and 6DoF X-ARM. We demonstrate that this combination of capabilities enables learning bimanual, whole-body, and active compliant policies that operate effectively in highly constrained spaces. The learned robust autonomous policies achieve high success rates across a variety of tasks, including long-horizon mobile manipulation, force-mediated box flipping, visually occluded box pushing, and space-constrained tabletop manipulation. Videos, code, and additional information can be found at https://ume-exo.github.io.
tldr: UME is a low-cost, lightweight upper-limb exoskeleton that provides real-time haptic torque feedback for teleoperating robots, enabling the learning of compliant whole-body policies for manipulation in constrained spaces.
tldr_zh: UME是一种低成本、轻量级的上肢外骨骼，通过实时触觉扭矩反馈实现机器人遥操作，从而学习在受限空间中进行柔性全身操控的策略。
summary_zh: 为使机器人能在家庭环境中安全作业，需具备柔顺性并在接触过程中响应力矩与力反馈。然而，现有大多数数据采集流程仍缺乏获取力与力矩数据以学习主动柔顺策略的能力。本文提出通用操控外骨骼（UME），这是一种上肢外骨骼系统，可在记录整臂构型与关节力矩信号用于遥操作的同时，提供实时触觉力矩反馈。凭借透明的力矩反馈，操作员甚至能在蒙眼状态下完成运动学约束物体的脱鞘操作。UME具有低成本、轻量化与便携特性，配备嵌入式惯性测量单元后，可实现移动操控的遥操作。通过我们提出的通用重定向算法，UME能操控多种机器人，包括7自由度OpenArm、7自由度Franka及6自由度X-ARM。我们证明，这种能力组合能够学习在高度受限空间中有效运作的双臂、全身及主动柔顺策略。经学习获得的鲁棒自主策略在多种任务中达成高成功率，涵盖长程移动操控、力介导的箱体翻转、视觉遮挡下的箱体推挤及空间受限的桌面操控。视频、代码及其他信息详见https://ume-exo.github.io。

title: GAIT: Legged Robot Proprioceptive State Estimation with Attention over Inertial-Leg Tokens
summary: In this paper, we propose a method that applies Inertial-Leg (IL) tokenization to an attention-based network for proprioceptive state estimation in legged robots. Unlike existing learning-based state estimators that concatenate all sensor measurements into a single flat vector, the proposed architecture represents inertial measurements and leg-wise measurements as individual tokens and uses an attention mechanism to learn the relative importance of each measurement.This design allows the network to reweight each measurement according to the current contact condition, reflecting the fact that the reliability of forward kinematic measurements depends on whether the corresponding foot is in contact. Unlike conventional contact-aided estimators, however, the proposed method learns this behavior without relying on an explicit contact estimator or on explicit measurement updates based on a stationary contact assumption. To validate the proposed method, we conducted experiments on a Unitree Go1 robot, including debris terrain not modeled in simulation and gait patterns not seen during training. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better estimation performance than existing learning-based state estimators under unseen gait patterns and also improves performance over contact-aided model-based methods.
tldr: Proposes an attention-based network using Inertial-Leg tokenization for proprioceptive state estimation in legged robots, outperforming existing methods on unseen gaits and terrain.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于注意力机制的惯性-腿部令牌化网络，用于腿部机器人的本体状态估计，在未见过的步态和地形上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于惯性-腿部（IL）标记化方法，将其应用于基于注意力的网络，以实现腿式机器人的本体状态估计。与现有基于学习的估计器将所有传感器测量值拼接为单一扁平向量不同，所提架构将惯性测量值和腿部测量值表示为独立标记，并通过注意力机制学习各测量的相对重要性。该设计使网络能够根据当前接触条件重新加权每个测量值，反映了前向运动学测量的可靠性取决于相应足部是否接触的事实。然而，与传统的接触辅助估计器不同，所提方法无需依赖显式接触估计器或基于静止接触假设的显式测量更新即可学习该行为。为验证所提方法，我们在宇树Go1机器人上进行了实验，包括仿真中未建模的碎屑地形以及训练中未见过的步态模式。实验结果表明，在未见步态模式下，所提方法比现有基于学习的状态估计器具有更优的估计性能，并且相较于基于模型且带接触辅助的方法也有所提升。

title: A Modular Dual-Arm Apple Harvesting Robot with Enhanced Field Performance
summary: Robotic apple harvesting offers a promising solution to labor shortages in commercial orchards, but low throughput and poor performance in orchard environments hinder its commercial adoption. This paper presents a modular dual-arm apple harvesting robot that uses a vertically stacked arms to enable simultaneous operation in the upper and lower zones of a single tree, simplifying platform positioning from multi-tree lateral repositioning to single-tree stops. Compared to our prior horizontal dual-arm system, the platform integrates 5 advances: (1)a foundation-model-based perception pipeline combining Grounding-DINO and EfficientViT-SAM for robust fruit localization in unstructured outdoor environments; (2)7th-order jerk-bounded trajectory generation paired with a Control Barrier Function safety filter to achieve fast yet safe arm motions; (3)a linear sweep harvesting strategy with a 10cm approach buffer and rotational detachment that improves picking reliability; (4)a temporal-logic-based dual-arm coordination policy with vision-arm async scheduling that maximizes usage of a shared vacuum source; and (5)field validation in 2 commercial orchards covering different apple varieties and tree architectures during the 2025 harvest season. Across the 1738 arm cycles collected in these field trials, the system achieved an 80.0% per-attempt success rate and a mean per-arm cycle time of 7.53s. Fruit damage assessments confirmed that 91.2% of robotically harvested fruit retained the highest USDA grade (Extra Fancy), with bruise rates between 2.4% and 4.9%. With further improvements in the picking cycle time and handling of heavy foliage occlusions, this new modular robot design holds promise for commercial harvesting of apples.
tldr: This paper presents a modular dual-arm apple harvesting robot with a foundation-model-based perception pipeline, jerk-bounded trajectory generation, and a temporal-logic-based dual-arm coordination policy, achieving 80% picking success and 7.53s cycle time in field trials across two commercial orchards.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种模块化双臂苹果采摘机器人，采用基础模型感知流水线、加加速度有界轨迹生成和时序逻辑双臂协调策略，在两个商业果园的田间试验中实现了80%的采摘成功率和7.53秒的循环时间。
summary_zh: 机器人苹果采摘为商业果园劳动力短缺问题提供了有前景的解决方案，但果园环境中存在吞吐量低、性能差等问题，阻碍了其商业化应用。本文提出了一种模块化双臂苹果采摘机器人，采用垂直堆叠式机械臂设计，可实现对单棵果树上下区域的同时操作，并将平台定位方式从多棵树横向重定位简化为单棵树停靠。与先前水平双臂系统相比，该平台集成了五项改进：（1）基于基础模型的感知流水线，融合Grounding-DINO与EfficientViT-SAM，实现非结构化户外环境下的稳健果实定位；（2）结合控制屏障函数安全滤波器的七阶加加速度有界轨迹生成，实现快速安全的机械臂运动；（3）采用含10厘米接近缓冲区与旋转脱离动作的线性扫描采摘策略，提升采摘可靠性；（4）基于时序逻辑的双臂协调策略及视觉-机械臂异步调度，最大化共享真空源利用率；（5）在2025年采收季于两个涵盖不同苹果品种与树形结构的商业果园完成田间验证。在田间试验采集的1738次机械臂循环中，系统单次尝试成功率达80.0%，平均单臂循环时间为7.53秒。果实损伤评估确认，91.2%的机器人采摘果实保持美国农业部最高等级（特级），碰伤率介于2.4%至4.9%之间。通过进一步缩短采摘循环时间并改善对茂密枝叶遮挡的处理能力，该新型模块化机器人设计有望实现苹果商业化采摘。

title: Self-Improving VLA Policies: Selected Diffusion Noise for Spurious-Robust Action Smoothing
summary: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies enable strong generalization in robotic manipulation, but remain sensitive to spurious visual correlations and noisy action generation, leading to brittle behavior under perturbations. We introduce Selected Diffusion Noise (SDN), a simple, training-free test-time method that improves both robustness and success rate by leveraging the diffusion noise space as a controllable degree of freedom. SDN dynamically samples noise vectors that are maximally separated from a reference set to mitigate reliance on spurious cues, while selecting candidates that yield more coherent action trajectories. This dual objective encourages stable behavior even under object-masked observations and reduces action jitter without modifying model parameters. We evaluate SDN on two simulation benchmarks (Google Robot, Widow-X) and two real-world robotic datasets across multiple VLA policies, including pi_0, Groot-N1.5, and Groot-N1.6. SDN consistently improves success rates by +8% in simulation and +10% in real-world settings, while producing smoother and more stable actions. Our results highlight that diffusion noise selection can serve as an effective and general mechanism for enhancing VLA policies at test time.
tldr: Proposes Selected Diffusion Noise (SDN), a training-free test-time method that improves robustness and success rate of diffusion-based VLA policies by dynamically selecting noise vectors to reduce reliance on spurious correlations and action jitter.
tldr_zh: 提出选择扩散噪声（SDN），一种无需训练、仅测试时使用的方法，通过动态选取噪声向量减少对虚假相关的依赖和动作抖动，从而提升扩散VLA策略的鲁棒性和成功率。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人操作中实现了强大的泛化能力，但仍对伪视觉相关性和噪声动作生成敏感，导致在扰动下表现脆弱。我们提出了一种简单的、无需训练的测试时方法——选择性扩散噪声（SDN），通过将扩散噪声空间作为可控自由度，同时提升鲁棒性和成功率。SDN动态采样与参考集合最大程度分离的噪声向量，以减轻对伪线索的依赖，同时选择能够生成更连贯动作轨迹的候选噪声。该双重目标即使在物体被遮挡的观测条件下也能促进稳定行为，并在不修改模型参数的情况下减少动作抖动。我们在两个仿真基准（Google Robot、Widow-X）和两个真实世界机器人数据集上评估了SDN，覆盖多种VLA策略（包括pi_0、Groot-N1.5和Groot-N1.6）。SDN在仿真环境中的成功率稳定提升8%，在真实场景中提升10%，同时生成更平滑、更稳定的动作。我们的研究结果表明，扩散噪声选择可作为一种在测试时增强VLA策略的有效通用机制。

title: ReactSim-Bench: Benchmarking Reactive Behavior World Model Simulation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Reactive capability is a key property of data-driven behavior world model simulators for autonomous driving simulation systems. With this capability, simulated world agents can respond feasibly to autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors that differ from the log. However, existing behavior simulation benchmarks do not directly measure reactive capability. They often let the simulator jointly control the AV and surrounding agents and evaluate realism through log similarity or open-loop prediction metrics. In this work, we introduce ReactSim-Bench for evaluating the reactive capability of behavior world model simulation in autonomous driving. We decouple the control of agents and the AV, using AV behaviors that differ from the log and require agents to respond as independent AV inputs. To obtain these AV behaviors, we construct a pipeline that uses an AV planner model to generate candidate behaviors and filters the data using rules and manual verification. Collision metrics, map-based metrics, and kinematic feasibility metrics are used to evaluate the safety and rule compliance of reactive responses. We construct 2,636 test scenarios with three categories and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art models across multiple architectures, including Transformer-based, diffusion-based, and next-token-prediction-based models. We further analyze how replan frequency affects performance and provide insights for future studies.
tldr: Introduces ReactSim-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the reactive capability of behavior world model simulators in autonomous driving by decoupling AV and agent control, testing responses to out-of-log AV behaviors.
tldr_zh: 提出了ReactSim-Bench，一个专门用于评估自动驾驶中行为世界模型模拟器反应能力的基准，通过解耦AV和智能体控制，测试对偏离日志的AV行为的响应。
summary_zh: 反应能力是自动驾驶仿真系统中数据驱动行为世界模型模拟器的关键特性。具备该能力后，仿真世界中的智能体能够对与日志记录不同的自动驾驶车辆行为做出合理响应。然而，现有行为仿真基准测试并未直接衡量反应能力。这些测试通常让模拟器联合控制自动驾驶车辆及周围智能体，并通过日志相似度或开环预测指标评估仿真效果。为此，我们提出ReactSim-Bench基准测试，用于评估自动驾驶行为世界模型仿真的反应能力。我们将智能体与自动驾驶车辆的控制解耦，采用与日志不同的自动驾驶车辆行为，并要求智能体将其作为独立输入进行响应。为获取这些自动驾驶车辆行为，我们构建了一套流程：利用自动驾驶规划器模型生成候选行为，并通过规则筛选与人工验证进行数据过滤。采用碰撞指标、基于地图的指标和运动学可行性指标，评估反应响应的安全性与规则遵守程度。我们构建了包含三类场景共2636个测试案例，并对基于Transformer、扩散模型及下一词元预测模型等多种架构的先进模型开展系统性评估。此外，我们分析了重规划频率对性能的影响，并为未来研究提供了洞见。

title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
summary: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representation introduces costly geometric decoding and slows down causal action generation. To address the trade-off, we present WAM4D, a fast 4D world action model that uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer pretrained geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer, then removes the register branch for lightweight action inference. To prevent non-causal shortcuts, we further design causal mixture attention for the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) WAM backbone, defining modality-specific visibility among video, action, and geometry tokens. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that WAM4D improves spatial consistency and achieves competitive action prediction while maintaining efficient inference.
tldr: WAM4D introduces lightweight spatial register tokens to inject pretrained geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer, enabling efficient 4D world action modeling with improved spatial consistency and competitive action prediction for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: WAM4D通过轻量级空间注册令牌将预训练的几何先验注入因果视频-动作变换器，实现了高效的4D世界动作建模，提升了空间一致性并保持了有竞争力的动作预测能力。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）近期在联合建模未来观测与可执行机器人动作方面展现出潜力。然而，现有WAMs大多仍运行于2D视频或潜在空间中，其视觉合理的推演缺乏精确操作所需的3D空间约束与遮挡接触几何结构。尽管几何基础模型为从视觉观测中恢复密集3D结构与运动提供了强大先验，但强制WAMs预测密集4D表示会引入昂贵的几何解码过程并拖慢因果动作生成。为平衡这一矛盾，我们提出WAM4D——一种快速4D世界动作模型，通过轻量级空间注册令牌作为训练时未来深度读出单元，将预训练的几何先验迁移至因果视频-动作变换器中，随后移除注册分支以实现轻量化动作推理。为避免非因果捷径，我们进一步为混合变换器（MoT）WAM主干设计了因果混合注意力机制，在视频、动作与几何令牌间定义模态特异性可见性。在RoboTwin 2.0及挑战性真实世界操作任务上的综合实验表明，WAM4D在保持高效推理的同时提升了空间一致性并实现了具竞争力的动作预测。

title: RT-VLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models via Knowledge Distillation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by jointly modeling visual perception, language reasoning, explainability and action prediction. However, their large vision-language backbones and reasoning modules introduce substantial inference latency and thereby prevent their deployment in the unforgiving reality of the road networks. We propose RT-VLA, a lightweight, distilled VLA model that transfers the driving and reasoning capabilities of the state-of-the-art SimLingo model into a compact student through multi-level supervised distillation. RT-VLA preserves language-based reasoning and supports post-hoc explanation through offline language analysis of safety-critical driving moments without adding latency to real-time control. Compared to the SimLingo teacher, RT-VLA maintains competitive closed-loop driving and language reasoning performance while reducing inference time by 44.8X in vision-only mode and 7.9X in vision+language mode. These results suggest that supervised distillation is a practical approach for building real-time, explainable VLA-style autonomous driving models.
tldr: RT-VLA uses multi-level supervised distillation to compress the SimLingo VLA model into a lightweight student for real-time autonomous driving, achieving competitive performance with up to 44.8× faster inference.
tldr_zh: RT-VLA通过多级监督蒸馏将SimLingo VLA模型压缩为轻量级学生模型，用于实时自动驾驶，在保持竞争力的同时实现了最高44.8倍的推理加速。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通过联合建模视觉感知、语言推理、可解释性和动作预测，在端到端自动驾驶方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，其庞大的视觉-语言骨干网络和推理模块会带来显著的推理延迟，从而阻碍其在苛刻的现实路网环境中部署。我们提出RT-VLA，一种轻量级、蒸馏后的VLA模型，通过多层监督蒸馏将先进SimLingo模型的驾驶与推理能力迁移至紧凑的学生模型。RT-VLA保留了基于语言的推理能力，并通过对安全关键驾驶时刻的离线语言分析支持事后解释，且不增加实时控制的延迟。与SimLingo教师模型相比，RT-VLA在保持有竞争力的闭环驾驶和语言推理性能的同时，在纯视觉模式下将推理时间降低了44.8倍，在视觉+语言模式下降低了7.9倍。这些结果表明，监督蒸馏是构建实时、可解释的VLA风格自动驾驶模型的一种实用方法。

title: AnyGoal: Vision-Language Guided Multi-Agent Exploration for Training-Free Lifelong Navigation
summary: End-to-end navigation policies trained on large simulation corpora degrade sharply when transferred to out-of-distribution scenes, categories, or goal modalities. Modular pipelines such as Modular GOAT are bottlenecked by closed-set object detection recall, while 3D snapshot-memory systems (e.g. 3D-Mem) accumulate dense, view-dependent representations that are heavy to maintain. We present AnyGoal, a training-free multi-robot architecture that places a Vision-Language Model (VLM) at the core of frontier-based exploration and coordinates agents through a shared 2D Gaussian Bayesian Value Map (BVM). The BVM maintains a per-pixel (mu, sigma^2) posterior over goal relevance, updated via precision-weighted fusion of VLM scores through a depth-cone mask, and is never reset between subtasks, yielding lifelong evidence accumulation. Frontiers are ranked by a convex blend of a VLM-as-judge softmax and a Bayesian UCB term on the BVM. A greedy allocator with spatial-separation penalty and commitment hysteresis distributes frontiers across agents without a centralized controller. On the full GOAT-Bench val unseen split (360 episodes, 2,669 subtasks), our dual-agent system achieves 52.4% Subtask SR at 12.7% SPL--state of the art under the strict physical regime (discrete 0.25 m steps, no teleportation, 42 deg HFOV) and a +27.5 pp improvement over Modular GOAT (24.9%). Single-agent AnyGoal achieves 41.9% Subtask SR, showing gains arise from the decision architecture. A four-way perception ablation shows that open-vocabulary detectors shift the dominant failure mode from exploration to goal verification.
tldr: AnyGoal proposes a training-free multi-robot navigation system that uses a VLM for frontier-based exploration and a shared Bayesian Value Map for lifelong evidence accumulation, achieving state-of-the-art subtask success on GOAT-Bench.
tldr_zh: AnyGoal 提出了一种无需训练的多机器人导航系统，利用 VLM 进行前沿探索，并通过共享的贝叶斯价值地图实现终身证据积累，在 GOAT-Bench 上达到了最先进的子任务成功率。
summary_zh: 在大规模仿真语料库上训练的端到端导航策略，在迁移至分布外场景、类别或目标模态时性能急剧下降。模块化流水线（如Modular GOAT）受限于封闭集目标检测的召回率，而3D快照记忆系统（例如3D-Mem）会积累密集且依赖视角的表征，维护成本高昂。我们提出AnyGoal，一种免训练的多机器人架构，该架构将视觉语言模型（VLM）置于基于边界的探索核心，并通过共享的二维高斯贝叶斯价值图（BVM）协调智能体。BVM维护每个像素关于目标相关性的（μ, σ²）后验分布，通过深度锥体掩码对VLM评分进行精度加权融合实现更新，且子任务间从不重置，从而获得终身证据积累。边界由VLM作为评判者的softmax项与BVM上的贝叶斯UCB项的凸组合进行排序。采用带有空间分离惩罚与承诺滞后的贪婪分配器，在无需中央控制器的情况下将边界分配至多个智能体。在完整的GOAT-Bench验证集未见分割（360个回合，2669个子任务）上，我们的双智能体系统在严格物理体制（离散0.25米步长，无瞬移，42度水平视场角）下达到52.4%的子任务成功率与12.7%的SPL，较Modular GOAT（24.9%）提升27.5个百分点，实现当前最优性能。单智能体AnyGoal达到41.9%的子任务成功率，表明性能提升源于决策架构。四维消融实验表明，开放词汇检测器将主要失败模式从探索转移至目标验证。

title: ContactWorld: What Matters in Vision-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires world models to reason over complex contact dynamics from multimodal sensory observations. However, it remains unclear which representation properties fundamentally support stable long-horizon planning in contact-rich settings. In this paper, we present ContactWorld, a benchmark and systematic empirical study of vision-tactile world models spanning 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, including insertion, disassembly, screwing, and exploratory interaction. Across extensive experiments, we find that representations that are both spatially structured and temporally continuous consistently achieve the strongest planning performance. In particular, point-cloud observations improve average planning success rates from 20.7% with wrist-view observations and 22.0% with front-view observations to 32.1%. We further find that the effectiveness of tactile sensing depends critically on cross-modal representation compatibility rather than modality scaling alone. Combining point-cloud observations with tactile force-field representations, which preserve richer spatial structure and interaction dynamics, further improves performance to 36.1%, yielding the strongest overall planning performance across all evaluated tasks. Moreover, tactile sensing becomes increasingly important under long-horizon planning objectives, where compounding prediction errors and contact uncertainty accumulate over time. Together, these findings highlight the importance of representation structure, multimodal compatibility, and long-horizon robustness in vision-tactile world models for contact-rich robotic manipulation.
tldr: A benchmark and empirical study evaluating vision-tactile world models for contact-rich manipulation, showing that spatially structured and temporally continuous representations (especially point-cloud and tactile force-field) improve long-horizon planning, with tactile sensing gaining importance over longer horizons.
tldr_zh: 一个针对接触丰富操作的视觉-触觉世界模型的基准与实证研究，表明空间结构化和时间连续的表示（尤其是点云和触觉力场）能提升长期规划性能，且触觉感知在更长规划周期中愈发重要。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作要求世界模型能够从多模态感官观测中推理复杂的接触动力学。然而，何种表示属性能在接触密集场景下从根本上支持稳定的长时域规划，目前尚不明确。本文提出ContactWorld——一个涵盖12项接触丰富操作任务（包括插入、拆卸、拧紧和探索性交互）的基准测试与系统性实证研究，专门用于研究视觉-触觉世界模型。通过大量实验发现，同时具备空间结构化与时间连续性的表示能持续获得最强的规划性能。具体而言，点云观测将平均规划成功率从腕部视角观测的20.7%和前置视角观测的22.0%提升至32.1%。进一步研究表明，触觉传感的有效性关键取决于跨模态表示的兼容性，而非单纯扩展模态数量。将点云观测与保留更丰富空间结构和交互动力学的触觉力场表示相结合，可将性能进一步提升至36.1%，在所有评估任务中取得最佳总体规划性能。此外，在长时域规划目标下（此时复合预测误差与接触不确定性随时间累积），触觉感知的重要性日益凸显。这些发现共同强调了接触丰富机器人操作中视觉-触觉世界模型的表示结构、多模态兼容性及长时域鲁棒性的关键作用。

title: Sensitivity Shaping for Latent Modeling
summary: Generative dynamics models enable planning in challenging robotic systems, but safe deployment requires reliably detecting policy-induced out-of-distribution (OOD) transitions. Existing methods typically treat the learned dynamics as fixed and attach post hoc support surrogates. We show that these surrogates can fail when the dynamics are locally insensitive to critical action choices: unsupported control actions may produce latent predictions that resemble demonstrated transitions, suppressing OOD signals despite large true predictive errors. To address this, we introduce support-conditioned control-sensitivity regularization, which promotes sensitive local response to control input changes in learned dynamics in high-support training regions. This preserves control-induced variation while limiting unstable extrapolation due to weak empirical support. Experiments in vision-based obstacle avoidance, manipulation, and real-robot navigation show improved OOD detection and safer closed-loop planning.
tldr: A sensitivity-shaping regularization method that makes learned dynamics models more responsive to control inputs in high-support regions, improving OOD detection and safety in closed-loop planning for vision-based obstacle avoidance, manipulation, and real-robot navigation.
tldr_zh: 一种敏感性塑造正则化方法，使学习到的动力学模型在高支持区域对控制输入更敏感，从而改善基于视觉的避障、操作和真实机器人导航中的OOD检测和闭环规划安全性。
summary_zh: 生成式动力学模型能够实现对高难度机器人系统的规划，但安全部署需要可靠地检测策略引发的分布外（OOD）转移。现有方法通常将学习到的动力学视为固定不变的，并附加后验支持代理。我们证明，当动力学对关键动作选择局部不敏感时，这些代理可能会失效：不受支持的控制动作可能产生与演示转移相似的潜在预测，从而在存在较大真实预测误差的情况下抑制OOD信号。为解决这一问题，我们提出了支持条件控制敏感性正则化方法，该方法促使学习到的动力学在高支持训练区域中对控制输入变化产生敏感的局部响应。这既保留了控制引发的变异，又限制了因实证支持不足导致的不稳定外推。在基于视觉的避障、操作任务以及真实机器人导航实验表明，该方法改进了OOD检测，并实现了更安全的闭环规划。

title: TRACE: Trajectory-Routed Causal Memory for Delayed-Evidence Visuomotor Imitation
summary: Robots under autonomous operation may require decisions based on evidence that is no longer visible. We study \emph{delayed-evidence} tasks, where an early cue disappears before a later decision point, so visually similar observations can require different actions. In these settings, the current observation is not a sufficient state for control. We introduce TRAjectory-routed Causal Evidence (TRACE), a memory framework for visuomotor imitation policies. TRACE stores task-relevant visual and robot-state evidence, such as object identity, target choice, or route-dependent state, in a fixed-size latent memory that remains bounded over long episodes. Instead of indexing memory by raw time or manually provided task labels, TRACE uses \emph{path signatures}: compact, order-sensitive features of the executed robot-state trajectory. These signatures do not store the visual cue itself; rather, they provide trajectory-conditioned keys for writing and retrieving the evidence stored when the cue was visible. When the robot later reaches an ambiguous observation, the policy conditions on TRACE memory to recover the missing context and choose the correct branch. TRACE attaches through lightweight adapters to policies, without changing the policy backbone, action head, or imitation objective. Across real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks with visually ambiguous branch points, TRACE improves branch selection and task success over alternative baselines, including short-history and recurrent memory. Project page: https://jeong-zju.github.io/trace
tldr: TRACE is a trajectory-conditioned memory framework for visuomotor imitation policies that uses path signatures to store and retrieve task-relevant visual evidence, enabling correct action selection in delayed-evidence manipulation tasks where critical cues are no longer visible.
tldr_zh: TRACE 是一种基于轨迹条件的记忆框架，用于视觉运动模仿策略，通过路径签名存储和检索任务相关的视觉证据，从而在关键线索消失的延迟证据操作任务中实现正确的动作选择。
summary_zh: 自主运行的机器人可能需要基于不再可见的证据做出决策。本文研究延迟证据任务，即早期线索在后续决策点前消失，因此视觉相似的观察结果可能需要不同的操作。在此类场景中，当前观测不足以作为控制的状态。我们提出轨迹路由因果证据（TRACE），一种用于视觉运动模仿策略的存储框架。TRACE将与任务相关的视觉和机器人状态证据（如物体身份、目标选择或路径依赖状态）存储于固定大小的潜在记忆体中，该记忆体在长周期内保持有界。TRACE不采用原始时间或手动提供的任务标签索引记忆，而是使用路径签名：已执行机器人状态轨迹的紧凑、顺序敏感的特征。这些签名不存储视觉线索本身，而是提供轨迹条件化的键，用于写入和检索线索可见时所存储的证据。当机器人后续遇到歧义观测时，策略基于TRACE记忆来恢复缺失上下文并选择正确分支。TRACE通过轻量适配器附加到策略上，无需改变策略主干、动作头或模仿目标。在包含视觉歧义分支点的真实世界长周期操控任务中，TRACE在分支选择和任务成功率方面优于替代基线方法（包括短历史存储与循环记忆）。项目页面：https://jeong-zju.github.io/trace

title: Kine2Go: Kinematic dataset for the Unitree Go2 robot with diverse gaits and motions
summary: The recent popularity of robotics, combined with the steadily decreasing cost of robotic hardware, has lowered the entry barrier to robotics research and enabled rapid advancements in the field. One of the primary examples is the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, which is often used by researchers in the areas of locomotion, navigation, control, and others. Many researchers use the Go2 robot in combination with techniques like imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and behavioral cloning to allow machine learning systems to take full control of the robot. At the same time, many of those techniques require demonstration data consisting of the robot's kinematics information and actions applied to the motors. Obtaining such data is difficult, requires building complex pipelines, and can take significant time. To aid in those kinds of efforts, we present Kine2Go - a dataset with 800 diverse gait kinematics trajectory motion data for the Unitree Go2 robot, derived from 40 distinct policies. Our pipeline accepts data from various quadruped morphologies and translates them to a Go2-compatible format. Then we use Reinforcement Learning to train policies following a given motion, and finally we gather data from those policies, which grants robust, perturbed kinematic data with corresponding motor-level actions.
tldr: Kine2Go provides a dataset of 800 kinematic trajectory motions for the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, generated from 40 different policies via a pipeline that translates motions from other morphologies and uses RL to collect robust data.
tldr_zh: Kine2Go为Unitree Go2四足机器人提供了一个包含800条不同步态运动学轨迹的数据集，该数据集源自40种不同的策略，通过将从其他形态转换的运动利用强化学习训练策略并收集鲁棒数据而生成。
summary_zh: 近年来机器人技术的普及，加之机器人硬件成本的持续下降，降低了机器人研究的准入门槛，并推动了该领域的快速发展。其中典型的例子是宇树Go2四足机器人，常被研究人员用于运动、导航、控制等领域。许多研究者将Go2机器人技术与模仿学习、强化学习、行为克隆等方法结合，使机器学习系统能够完全控制该机器人。与此同时，这些技术中的多数需要包含机器人运动学信息及电机动作的演示数据。获取此类数据极为困难，需构建复杂的数据处理流程，且耗时显著。为助力此类研究，我们提出Kine2Go数据集——包含源自40种不同策略的800条多样化步态运动学轨迹数据，专为宇树Go2机器人设计。我们的数据处理流程能兼容不同形态四足机器人的数据，并将其转换为Go2适配格式。随后利用强化学习根据指定运动训练策略，最终从这些策略中收集数据，从而获得带有对应电机级动作的鲁棒运动学扰动数据。

title: Robust Fall Recovery for Armless Bipedal-Wheeled Robots Via Force-Guided Learning
summary: Fall recovery is critical for autonomous legged locomotion. Existing methods have demonstrated that some legged robots, such as humanoids and quadrupeds, are capable of fall recovery from diverse postures by utilizing arms or coordinating multi-legs to generate support forces. Without arms or other legs to provide supportive assistance, a bipedal-wheeled robot must rely solely on the actuation of its legs, making recovery particularly difficult. To address this, we introduce FTSR (Force-guided Teacher-student framework with Stage-wise Rewards). The force-guided method constructs an external auxiliary force during simulation training that correlates directly with the robot's real-time height, explicitly formulating this force as an optimizable constraint. Through constrained reinforcement learning, the policy is guided toward reducing force dependency gradually and increasing the body height, developing internal recovery strategies despite having no arms for support. Height-progressive stage-Wise rewards progressively structure posture stabilization during recovery and transition to sustained locomotion, integrated with teacher-student architecture distilling privileged knowledge of force effects and recovery dynamics. After simulation training, the policy is deployed on a physical armless bipedal-wheeled robot and extensively evaluated. Experiments confirm robust and reliable fall recovery under diverse challenging conditions, demonstrating strong environmental adaptability and motion robustness, while maintaining full post-recovery motion capability. The framework also generalizes effectively to a high-DOF humanoid, confirming its practical generalizability. The project page is available at https://2350575870.github.io/force-guided.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces FTSR, a force-guided teacher-student framework with stage-wise rewards that enables a bipedal-wheeled robot without arms to robustly recover from falls by learning to transition from external force support to internal recovery strategies through constrained reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FTSR框架，通过力引导的教师-学生结构和阶段性奖励，使无臂双轮足机器人在无手臂支撑的情况下，通过约束强化学习从外部辅助力过渡到内部恢复策略，实现鲁棒的摔倒恢复。
summary_zh: 跌落恢复对于自主腿式 locomotion 至关重要。现有方法已证明，部分腿式机器人（如人形机器人与四足机器人）能够通过使用手臂或协调多腿产生支撑力，从多种姿态实现跌落恢复。对于不具备手臂或其他腿部提供支撑辅助的双轮足式机器人而言，其必须仅依靠腿部驱动完成恢复，这使得恢复过程尤为困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FTSR（力引导的教师-学生框架与分阶段奖励）。力引导方法在仿真训练中构建与机器人实时高度直接相关的外部辅助力，并将该力显式表述为可优化约束。通过约束强化学习，策略被引导逐步降低对力的依赖并提升身体高度，从而在无手臂支撑的情况下发展出内部恢复策略。基于高度渐进的分阶段奖励逐步构建恢复过程中的姿态稳定性并过渡至持续运动，同时结合教师-学生架构蒸馏关于力效应与恢复动力学的特权知识。经过仿真训练后，该策略被部署于物理无手臂双轮足式机器人并进行广泛评估。实验证实，机器人在多种挑战性条件下均能实现稳健可靠的跌落恢复，展现出强大的环境适应性与运动鲁棒性，同时保持完全的后恢复运动能力。该框架还能有效泛化至高自由度人形机器人，验证了其实际通用性。项目页面详见 https://2350575870.github.io/force-guided.github.io/

title: SyLink Hand: A Synergy-Inspired Linkage-Driven Anthropomorphic Hand for Human-Like Dexterity
summary: Designing anthropomorphic robotic hands that balance functional dexterity with mechanical simplicity remains a significant challenge. Inspired by human hand synergies, this paper presents the SyLink Hand, an anthropomorphic dexterous hand that integrates biomechanical synergy principles with linkage-driven transmission mechanisms to achieve a high degree of anthropomorphism in appearance, kinematics, and functionality within a compact and cost-effective architecture. Biomechanical analysis of natural hand motions using motion capture gloves reveals strong kinematic correlations among hand joints, providing the basis for a simplified yet functional degree-of-freedom (DOF) configuration. Guided by these synergistic characteristics, optimized linkage mechanisms are employed to coordinate multiple joint motions and reproduce natural finger trajectories. A novel spherical four-bar linkage is further proposed to achieve decoupled flexion/extension (Flex/Ext) and abduction/adduction (Abd/Add) at the metacarpophalangeal joint within a compact form factor. The resulting prototype integrates 19 joints driven by 11 actuators, with a total mass of 520g and a manufacturing cost of approximately USD 400. Experimental evaluations demonstrate its human-like kinematic performance, high load-bearing capability, and versatile grasping and manipulation skills. These results validate that the synergy-inspired, linkage-based design effectively balances anthropomorphism, mechanical simplicity, and functional versatility, highlighting its potential for practical deployment in dexterity-demanding robotic applications.
tldr: This paper presents the SyLink Hand, an anthropomorphic robotic hand designed using biomechanical synergy principles and linkage-driven mechanisms to achieve human-like dexterity with a compact, low-cost, 11-actuator system. Experimental results validate its kinematic performance, load-bearing capacity, and versatility in grasping and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SyLink Hand，一种基于生物力学协同原理和连杆驱动机构设计的拟人化机械手，以11个执行器实现了类人灵巧性，实验验证了其运动学性能、承载能力和抓取操作的多样性。
summary_zh: 设计兼具灵巧操作能力与机械简洁性的仿人机械手仍是重大挑战。受人类手部协同作用启发，本文提出SyLink手——一种集成了生物力学协同原理与连杆驱动传动机构的仿人灵巧手，在紧凑且低成本的架构中实现了外观、运动学与功能的高度仿人特性。通过动作捕捉手套对自然手部运动进行生物力学分析，揭示了手部关节间的强运动学相关性，为简化且功能有效的自由度配置提供了基础。基于这些协同特征，采用优化连杆机构协调多关节运动，复现自然手指运动轨迹。进一步提出新型球面四杆机构，在紧凑外形尺寸下实现掌指关节屈伸与外展内收的解耦控制。最终样机集成了由11个驱动器驱动的19个关节，总质量520g，制造成本约400美元。实验评估表明，该样机具备类人运动学性能、高承载能力及多功能的抓取与操作技能。这些结果验证了受协同启发的连杆设计有效平衡了仿人性、机械简洁性与功能多样性，凸显了其在灵巧需求型机器人应用中的实用潜力。

title: Short-Horizon Position Accuracy of Single-Track Models: Implications for Motion Planning of Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Accurate and computationally efficient vehicle models are essential for motion planning of autonomous vehicles, where positional accuracy directly affects trajectory feasibility and safety. However, the positional accuracy has not been systematically evaluated against real measurements. Therefore, this paper compares the short-horizon positional accuracy of three single-track vehicle models against vehicle measurements across various driving maneuvers. Model parameters are identified through dedicated experiments with the instrumented test vehicle. Rather than identifying a single best model, this work aims to provide insight into the trade-offs between model complexity, parameterization quality, and positional accuracy for informed model selection in Model Predictive Control applications.
authors: Lars A. T. H. van Alen
René M. J. G. van de Molengraft
tldr: This paper evaluates the short-horizon positional accuracy of three single-track vehicle models against real measurements, analyzing trade-offs between model complexity, parameterization quality, and accuracy for informed model selection in Model Predictive Control for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文针对三种单轨车辆模型的短时位置精度与真实测量数据进行了对比，分析了模型复杂度、参数化质量与精度之间的权衡，以指导自动驾驶中模型预测控制的模型选择。
summary_zh: 精确且计算高效的车辆模型对于自动驾驶车辆的运动规划至关重要，其中位置精度直接影响轨迹可行性与安全性。然而，现有研究尚未基于真实测量数据对位置精度进行系统性评估。为此，本文通过多种驾驶工况下的车辆实测数据，对比了三种单轨车辆模型在短时域内的位置精度。模型参数通过搭载测量仪器的测试车辆的专项实验进行辨识。本研究并非旨在确定单一最优模型，而是深入揭示模型复杂度、参数化质量与位置精度之间的权衡关系，为模型预测控制应用中的模型选择提供决策依据。

title: Robustness without Wrinkles: Parallel Simulation and Robust MPC for Certified Deformable Manipulation
summary: We present CORD-SLS, a real-time control method for safe deformable object manipulation, with a focus on ropes and cloth. At its core is a GPU-parallel differentiable simulator with contact smoothing which enables efficient gradient-based planning through intermittent contact. To robustly satisfy constraints under model and sensing uncertainty, we develop a real-time, GPU-parallel output-feedback robust model predictive control (MPC) algorithm that plans with this simulator. We further show that the simulator accelerates model-based RL for training neural manipulation policies. To improve real-world robustness, we use conformal prediction to calibrate visual-feedback and perception-error bounds for MPC, producing reachable tubes that enable high-probability safe control. We evaluate CORD-SLS on high-dimensional, contact-rich rope and cloth manipulation tasks in simulation and hardware, including obstacle avoidance, routing, folding, and smoothing. Across settings, CORD-SLS achieves millisecond-speed planning, exceeding baselines in safety, speed, and task success.
tldr: This paper presents CORD-SLS, a real-time control method for deformable object manipulation that combines a GPU-parallel differentiable simulator, robust MPC with conformal prediction for safety guarantees, and demonstrates fast planning on rope and cloth tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CORD-SLS，一种用于可变形物体操作的实时控制方法，结合GPU并行可微模拟器、鲁棒MPC以及保形预测实现安全保障，在绳索和布料任务中实现毫秒级规划。
summary_zh: 我们提出CORD-SLS，一种面向绳子和布料等可变形物体的安全操控实时控制方法。其核心是一个具有接触平滑功能的GPU并行可微仿真器，能够通过间歇性接触实现高效的基于梯度的规划。为了在模型与感知不确定性下稳健地满足约束条件，我们开发了一种实时、GPU并行的输出反馈鲁棒模型预测控制（MPC）算法，该算法依托此仿真器进行规划。我们进一步证明，该仿真器可加速基于模型的强化学习，用于训练神经操控策略。为提升实际应用中的鲁棒性，我们利用保形预测对MPC的视觉反馈与感知误差界限进行校准，从而生成可达管集以实现高概率的安全控制。我们在仿真与硬件平台上对CORD-SLS进行了高维度、高接触密度的绳子和布料操控任务评估，涵盖避障、路径规划、折叠与展平等场景。在各类设置下，CORD-SLS均实现了毫秒级规划速度，在安全性、速度及任务成功率上均超越基准方法。

title: SplatlessDF: Continuous Distance Field Mapping with Non-Splatting Gaussians
summary: Recent Gaussian splatting (GS) methods have shown that scenes can be represented efficiently with optimisable Gaussians for high-quality reconstruction and rendering. In this paper, building on this principle, we introduce SplatlessDF, a continuous distance field (DF) mapping framework that uses anisotropic Gaussian elements from a spatial rather than photometric perspective. SplatlessDF directly parameterises the Gaussians and optimises to recover a differentiable DF, enabling distances and gradients to be queried in the spatial domain for downstream robotic tasks such as navigation. Furthermore, SplatlessDF can be coupled with 2D Gaussian splatting (2DGS), providing a unified framework based solely on Gaussian primitives that can learn continuous DF and surface models and supports photometric rendering. We consider two settings: a standalone DF-only formulation and a joint DF-rendering formulation coupled with 2DGS. Experiments show that the standalone formulation provides efficient and accurate distance and gradient queries, while the joint formulation improves rendering geometry and simultaneously models a continuous DF. These results highlight the potential of GS-style representations not only for surface modelling and rendering but also for mapping representations suited to robotic navigation.
tldr: SplatlessDF uses non-splatting Gaussian primitives to learn continuous distance fields from a spatial perspective, enabling distance/gradient queries for robotic navigation, and can be coupled with 2D Gaussian splatting for joint distance field and surface reconstruction with rendering.
tldr_zh: SplatlessDF 利用非溅射的高斯基元从空间角度学习连续距离场，支持机器人导航所需的距离和梯度查询，并能与 2D 高斯溅射结合实现距离场和表面模型的联合重建与渲染。
summary_zh: 近期的高斯泼溅（GS）方法表明，场景可通过可优化的高斯元素高效表示，以实现高质量的重建与渲染。基于这一原理，本文提出SplatlessDF——一种连续距离场（DF）建图框架，该框架从空间视角而非光度视角出发，利用各向异性高斯元素。SplatlessDF直接参数化高斯元素并优化以恢复可微距离场，从而可在空间域中查询距离与梯度，支持导航等下游机器人任务。此外，SplatlessDF可与二维高斯泼溅（2DGS）结合，形成完全基于高斯原语的统一框架，既能学习连续距离场与表面模型，又支持光度渲染。我们考虑两种设置：独立仅距离场公式，以及与2DGS耦合的联合距离场-渲染公式。实验表明，独立公式可提供高效精确的距离与梯度查询，而联合公式在改进渲染几何的同时，同步建模连续距离场。这些结果凸显了GS类表示方法在表面建模与渲染之外，亦适用于机器人导航建图表示的巨大潜力。

title: An Attention-based Model for Robust Forecasting with Missing Modality
summary: Learning with missing modalities is a fundamental challenge in multimodal robot learning, as real-world robotic systems often operate in environments with incomplete sensor data. Attention-based models are appealing for processing multimodal data because they can handle multiple modalities with a single backbone network. However, most multimodal models assume that all modalities are available during both training and inference, limiting their applicability in robotic perception and decision-making. In this paper, we introduce a multimodal model designed to handle missing modalities during both training and inference. The model is formulated as a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and incorporates a transformer-based architecture that leverages attention mechanisms to learn a unified, fixed-dimensional representation, even when some modalities are missing. We show that our proposed model can be trained with missing modalities while approximating a robust representation of all modalities. We evaluate our approach on five multimodal datasets across two robot learning tasks: human trajectory prediction and robot manipulation forecasting. Experimental results demonstrate that our model effectively learns from incomplete data and is superior to prior multimodal fusion approaches.
tldr: This paper proposes a transformer-based CVAE model that learns a fixed-dimensional representation from multimodal data even when some modalities are missing, and evaluates it on human trajectory prediction and robot manipulation forecasting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的CVAE模型，即使在部分模态缺失的情况下也能从多模态数据中学习固定维度的表示，并在人类轨迹预测和机器人操作预测任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 学习过程中存在模态缺失是多模态机器人学习中的一个基本挑战，因为现实世界的机器人系统往往在传感器数据不完整的环境中运行。基于注意力的模型因其能够通过单一骨干网络处理多种模态，在处理多模态数据方面具有吸引力。然而，大多数多模态模型假设在训练和推理过程中所有模态均可用，这限制了它们在机器人感知与决策中的适用性。本文提出了一种能够在训练和推理过程中处理模态缺失的多模态模型。该模型被构建为条件变分自编码器（CVAE），并采用基于Transformer的架构，利用注意力机制学习统一的、固定维度的表征，即使在某些模态缺失的情况下也能实现。我们证明，所提出的模型能够在缺失模态的条件下进行训练，同时逼近对所有模态的鲁棒表征。我们在两个机器人学习任务（人体轨迹预测与机器人操作预测）的五个多模态数据集上评估了该方法。实验结果表明，该模型能够有效从不完整数据中学习，并且优于先前的多模态融合方法。

title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving: From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models
summary: Autonomous driving is shifting from isolated vehicle intelligence toward multi-agent embodied systems that share perception, infer intent, and coordinate action under uncertainty. This survey examines this transition through the lens of Shared World Models (SWMs): predictive cross-agent representations maintained across vehicles, infrastructure, and other traffic participants. We review more than 380 publications spanning vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, collaborative perception, inter-agent cognition, cooperative planning, end-to-end cooperative driving, and simulation and data engines for closed-loop validation. The organizing question is how exchanged observations become aligned state, intent-aware interaction, and coordinated downstream action. Across the surveyed literature, evaluation remains concentrated in simulation, curated benchmarks, and offline protocols. Foundation-model-based coordination also lacks verified real-time safety guarantees in open traffic. These gaps motivate key research priorities for multi-agent embodied autonomous driving (MAEAD): verifiable shared-state maintenance, robust intent and plan alignment, and safe coordinated action under communication, latency, and deployment constraints.
tldr: A survey examining the transition from isolated autonomous driving to multi-agent embodied systems via Shared World Models (SWMs), reviewing over 380 papers on V2X communication, collaborative perception, cooperative planning, and simulation validation.
tldr_zh: 一篇综述论文，探讨从孤立自动驾驶向多智能体具身系统的转变，通过共享世界模型（SWMs）整合车辆与环境间的感知、意图推断与协同规划，回顾了380余篇相关文献。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶正从单一车辆智能向多智能体具身系统演进，此类系统在不确定性条件下共享感知、推断意图并协调行动。本综述以共享世界模型（SWMs）为视角审视这一转变：该模型是跨车辆、基础设施及其他交通参与者维护的预测性跨智能体表征。我们回顾了380余篇文献，涵盖车联万物（V2X）通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协作规划、端到端协作驾驶，以及用于闭环验证的仿真与数据引擎。核心研究问题在于：交换的观测数据如何转化为对齐的状态、具有意图感知的交互以及协调的下游行动。纵观所综述文献，评估仍集中在仿真环境、标准基准测试及离线协议中。基于基础模型的协调机制在开放交通场景下尚缺乏经过验证的实时安全保证。这些差距为多智能体具身自动驾驶（MAEAD）提出了关键研究优先级：可验证的共享状态维护、稳健的意图与计划对齐，以及在通信、延迟与部署约束下实现安全协调行动。

title: FlowMo-WM: A World Model with Object Momentum and Hidden Ambient Drift
summary: World models in robot learning predict future states from visual observations and actions, enabling agents to reason about the consequences of their controls. However, many action-conditioned models are evaluated in settings where motion is dominated by immediate control, whereas aquatic surface vehicles and other real-world objects continue moving under inertia and are displaced by hidden ambient drift, such as water currents or wind. We propose FlowMo-WM, an end-to-end trainable visual world model that infers object-centric motion state and a predictive long-history context associated with hidden drift from image-action histories without direct supervision of flow fields. FlowMo-WM factorizes image-action history into a short-history latent state, trained to summarize object-centric motion, and a longer-history context, trained to summarize slowly varying exogenous influences. A zero-context residual transition separates action-conditioned base dynamics from context-dependent drift effects during latent rollout. In simulated aquatic surface-vehicle environments with diverse hidden flows, disturbances, and randomized vehicle dynamics, FlowMo-WM improves long-horizon rollout accuracy over representative action-conditioned latent world models.
